name: Welcome to 2019
information:
With the competition happening over New Years, we strongly recommend that you sleep at the hotel that the competition is located in. This is due to the fact that New Years is one of the riskiest nights in regards to drunk driving.

You can either get yourself a private room or split the room with other competitors. For more information on the rooms we have reserved for competitors and private rooms, please refer to the "[Hotel Information + FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Welcometo2019#8093-hotel-information-faq)" Tab.

Thank you to [Jason White](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/2016WHIT16) for coming up with this competition idea!
